instruction: Review all changes from benchmark-base through the final on-disk worktree, including committed, staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted files. Do not fix, stage, or commit anything. config.resolve(defaults, file_values, env_values) returns a new merged dictionary with precedence environment > file > defaults for each key. An empty string is a present environment override. Preserve inputs. Review the final worktree rather than assuming the staged version is the candidate. Attribute each defect to the responsible function or file rather than a forwarding caller. Report no findings when every change satisfies the stated contract.
